title: How AI Is Fixing the Biggest Bottleneck in Construction
episode_topic: Olek Baraska discusses how Togal AI is revolutionizing the construction industry by automating pre-construction processes. He highlights the inefficiencies in traditional construction methods and explains how AI can streamline project estimating and planning, ultimately addressing the housing crisis.

title: Why Traditional App Security Fails in the Age of AI
episode_topic: Subho Halder discusses the evolving landscape of mobile application security in the context of rapid AI advancements. He highlights the challenges posed by the increasing complexity of applications and the need for security measures that adapt to this dynamic environment.

title: Carter Huffman: Exploring The Architecture Behind Modulate's Next-Gen Voice AI
episode_topic: Carter Huffman discusses the innovative voice AI technology developed by Modulate, focusing on real-time voice analysis for applications in gaming and safety. He explains the architecture of their ensemble models, which enhance emotion detection and lie detection, and the potential for broader applications in various industries.

title: Nick Frosst: Why Cohere Is Betting on Enterprise AI, Not AGI
episode_topic: Nick Frosst discusses Cohere's focus on enterprise AI solutions rather than pursuing artificial general intelligence (AGI). He explains the company's approach to making large language models efficient and useful for businesses, emphasizing the importance of tailored applications and capital efficiency.

title: The Widening AI Value Gap with Amanda Luther
episode_topic: Amanda Luther discusses the widening value gap in AI adoption between early adopters and laggards, highlighting the importance of investment in AI capabilities and the impact on business performance. She shares insights from BCG's annual study on AI's effects across various industries.

title: David Ha: Why Model Merging Could Be the Next AI Breakthrough
episode_topic: David Ha discusses the concept of model merging in AI, exploring how evolutionary strategies can enhance AI capabilities. He shares insights from his work at Sakana AI, focusing on the intersection of generative AI and evolutionary computation.

title: Sharon Zhou: Inside AMD's Plan to Build Self-Improving AI
episode_topic: Sharon Zhou discusses AMD's initiatives in self-improving AI, focusing on kernel optimization for GPUs and the challenges of catastrophic forgetting in AI models. She elaborates on the role of AI in enhancing hardware performance and the importance of making AI accessible to a broader audience.

title: Why AI's Future Depends on Human Judgement
episode_topic: Phelim Brady discusses the critical role of human judgment in AI development, emphasizing the importance of high-quality data collection and evaluation. He explains how Prolific connects researchers with verified participants to enhance the reliability of AI models.

title: Inside Pathway's Post-Transformer Architecture Designed for Memory and On-the-Fly Learning
episode_topic: Zuzanna Stamirowska discusses the innovative post-transformer architecture developed at Pathway, focusing on memory and on-the-fly learning. She explains how this architecture differs from traditional LLMs by incorporating memory to enhance reasoning and creativity.

title: Baris Gultekin: The Next Phase of AI - Agents That Understand Your Company's Data
episode_topic: Baris Gultekin discusses the evolution of AI at Snowflake, focusing on the integration of AI with data governance and security. He highlights the development of data agents that allow users to interact with their data in natural language, emphasizing the importance of high-quality data retrieval and the transformative potential of AI in enterprise settings.

title: AI Deepfakes And Broken Trust
episode_topic: Kevin Tian discusses the existential threat posed by AI deepfakes and social engineering attacks. He explains how his company, Doppel, uses AI to combat these threats by detecting impersonation attacks and providing training to organizations.

title: Quantum Elements: Enhancing Quantum Computing with Digital Twins
episode_topic: Izhar discusses the innovative use of digital twins and AI to optimize quantum computing systems. He explains how these technologies can enhance the accuracy and efficiency of quantum algorithms, particularly in error correction and noise management.

title: Sebastian Risi: Why AI Should Be Grown, Not Trained
episode_topic: Sebastian Risi discusses the concept of neuroevolution, which combines evolutionary algorithms with neural networks to optimize their architecture and learning rules. He emphasizes the potential of self-growing networks inspired by biological systems, aiming for continual learning and adaptability in AI.

title: The Robot Revolution Nobody Is Talking About
episode_topic: Sergey Levine discusses the advancements in robotic foundation models and their implications for general-purpose robots. He emphasizes the importance of diverse data sources and the challenges of deploying robots in real-world environments.

title: The Code Is Clean. The App Is Broken: AI Development Integrity
episode_topic: Dan Faulkner discusses the integrity challenges in AI-driven software development, emphasizing the need for continuous application testing and the risks associated with rapid coding practices. He highlights the importance of maintaining application integrity amidst the increasing reliance on AI tools and the potential systemic risks that arise from agentic workflows.

title: Shadow AI Meets Enterprise Controls
episode_topic: The episode discusses the challenges and opportunities of integrating agentic AI into enterprise processes. Adi Kuruganti explains how Automation Anywhere is leveraging AI to enhance operational productivity, compliance, and governance while addressing the rapid evolution of AI technologies.

title: Abhishek Singh: The $1.2 Billion Plan to Turn India Into an AI Superpower
episode_topic: Abhishek Singh discusses India's ambitious $1.2 billion AI mission aimed at transforming the country into an AI superpower. He outlines the challenges and strategies involved in building AI infrastructure, enhancing data accessibility, and fostering talent within the nation.

title: Sriram Raghavan: Why IBM Is Betting Everything on Small AI Models
episode_topic: Sriram Raghavan discusses IBM's focus on developing smaller AI models, specifically the Granite series, and the advantages of direct training over distillation. He emphasizes the importance of data quality, inference scaling, and the evolving landscape of AI architecture.

title: Why India Is Losing the AI Race and What It Will Take to Catch Up
episode_topic: Professor Mausam discusses the reasons behind India's lag in AI development compared to China and the US, highlighting systemic issues in academia, funding, and talent retention. He emphasizes the need for a robust research culture and the importance of attracting top professors to foster innovation in AI.

title: Debdas Sen: Why AI Without ROI Will Die (Again)
episode_topic: Debdas Sen discusses the evolution of AI and its integration into digital transformation, emphasizing the importance of ROI for AI initiatives. He explains how TCG Digital's MCube platform leverages both internal and external data to optimize complex industrial processes, particularly in sectors like energy and life sciences.

title: Amith Singhee: Can India Catch Up in AI?
episode_topic: Amith Singhee discusses the challenges and opportunities for India in the AI landscape, emphasizing the need for investment, talent, and infrastructure to accelerate progress. He shares insights on IBM's research focus in India and the potential for the country to leverage AI for economic growth.
